title: How Much Reasoning Do Retrieval-Augmented Models Add beyond LLMs? A Benchmarking Framework for Multi-Hop Inference over Hybrid Knowledge
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmarking framework for evaluating the retrieval and multi-hop reasoning capabilities of large language models across scientific domains (AI, policy, and bioinformatics). It does not include components related to benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
